title: The War Fought With Whisky
description:
Canada and Denmark both claimed Hans Island, a barren, uninhabited rock of about 1.3 square kilometers in the Arctic. Instead of fighting, each side's visitors left a flag, a sign and a bottle: Danish schnapps and Canadian Club whisky. The dispute was nicknamed the Whisky War and described as the friendliest war ever. In 2005 it even moved to online ads, and Canada said it would keep selling Danish pastries as a goodwill gesture. In 2022, after 17 years of talks, the two countries agreed to split the island nearly in half.

Sources: Wikipedia, 'Hans Island'.
